tensura.skill.seeker.description:
Copies eligible projectile magic within 15 blocks.
*Hold* on the same shot for 3s (1s mastered) to learn it.
*Toggle*: faster chanting, movement and attacks.
{P}: grants Law Manipulation.
tensura.skill.seer.description:
While toggled: +25% melee/projectile dodge, +33% crit; direct melee hits deal ×0.7 damage (50%, 50%, ×0.5 mastered).
*Toggle*: these bonuses.
*Press*: +100% dodge, crit and dodge negation for 10s (20 mastered); press again to end.
tensura.skill.severer.description:
Creates spatial swords and flying blades.
[Dummy Sword] *press*: fill an empty hand.
[Blade Storm] *press* with a spatial sword: 5 blades (10 mastered); 2,000 magicule.
[Severance] *press*: +10 attack (+20 mastered) for 120s.
tensura.skill.shadow_striker.description:
Dash attacks and direct soul damage.
[Ultra Acceleration] *press* on ground: dash 15 blocks (20 mastered), striking foes.
[Insta-kill]: melee hits deal 500 soul damage (1,000 mastered); 3,000 magicule.
[Espionage] *hold*: concealment; mastered: *press* to toggle.
*Toggle skill*: faster chanting, movement, attacks and better dodges.
tensura.skill.sloth.description:
Drowsiness, magicule drain and healing.
[Deep Hypno] *hold*: drowsy target; *press*: cancel a spell.
[Fallen Hypno] *hold*: drowsy aura, 5 blocks (10 mastered).
[Deprive] *hold*: drain 1,000 magicule/s.
[Rest] *hold*: heal 10 HP/s; *sneak+press*: heal allies.
[Phantasmal Style] *press* to learn; *toggle*: soul hits.
[Fallen Strike] *press*: 500 soul damage; 5,000 magicule.
tensura.skill.spearhead.description:
{P}: allies within 20 blocks gain +10 attack, +5 armor and faster movement/swimming (double mastered). Inherit eligible skills from nearby dead followers.
*Press*: all followers stay/follow/wander/shield you.
*Sneak+press*: order one follower.
tensura.skill.starved.description:
Corrosion can steal skills from its kills.
[Corrosion] *hold*: 5 damage/0.5s within 5 blocks; slows you.
[Stomach] *press*: storage.
[Receive] *press*: copy a follower’s skills.
[Provide]: unfinished.
[Spiritual Domination] *press*: order one follower; *sneak+press*: all stay/follow/wander/rampage.
tensura.skill.suppressor.description:
Blocks warping and moves entities through space.
[Spatial Suppression] *press*: foes within 25 blocks cannot warp for 60s.
[Swap] *press*: trade places with a target within 30 blocks.
[Spatial Motion] *press*: blink 30 blocks (50 mastered); *sneak+press*: warp/gate menu.
*Toggle*: faster chanting, movement and attacks.
tensura.skill.thrower.description:
Throws held items (base damage 50; 100 mastered) or air (30; 50 mastered). Special items vary.
*Press*: throw; aiming at a creature within 4 blocks shoves it instead.
*Toggle*: ordinary thrown items home toward your target.
tensura.skill.traveler.description:
Blinks and fires spatial arrows.
[Instant Motion] *press*: blink up to 200 blocks.
[Teleport] *press*: warp/gate menu.
[Spatial Manipulation] *press*: toggle Warp Shot.
[Stardust Arrow] *press*: 30 damage; *sneak+press*: fire from behind target.
[Stardust Rain] *press*: 12 ×30-damage arrows; 5,000 each aura/magicule.
*Toggle skill*: ×2 space power.
tensura.skill.unyielding.description:
{P}: named followers within 30 blocks build points for inheriting their EP and skills on death.
[Default] *press* at an ally: check points.
[Backup] *press*: create a spare body (25% max magicule), then swap to it; also saves you on death.
*Sneak+press*: dismiss backup.
tensura.skill.usurper.description:
Takes random skills from targets within 10 blocks.
[Rob] *press*: may steal from a stronger foe; 1,000 magicule.
[Copy] *press*: may copy; 1,000.
[Force Takeover] *press*: seize a summon (owner ≤75% your EP) for 300s (600 mastered), or rob a weaker foe; 5,000.
*Sneak+press* in [Force Takeover]: return a seized summon.
tensura.skill.villain.description:
{P}: boosts allies within 15 blocks while equipped.
[Demon Lord's Haki] *hold*: frighten weaker foes.
[Villain's Charisma] *press*: control eligible peaceful foes within 10 blocks for 120s (60 if resisted).
*Scroll* (mastered): Power Scale.
*Toggle*: more EP from kills; mastered: Haki Coat.
tensura.skill.wrath.description:
Regenerates magicule; risks Rampage and HP/soul loss as it wears off.
[Breeder Reactor] *hold*: gain 2% max magicule every 5s; may gain Rampage for 30s. Mastered: can toggle.
[Enrage] *hold*: escalating Rampage on foes within 7 blocks, initially 20s.
